# doit_budget_suggestions (Data Source)

List the pending AI-generated budget suggestions for the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "doit_budget_suggestions" "all" {}

output "pending_suggestion_count" {
  value = data.doit_budget_suggestions.all.row_count
}

output "suggestion_summary" {
  value = [for s in data.doit_budget_suggestions.all.items : {
    id         = s.id
    name       = s.name
    confidence = s.confidence
    status     = s.status
    amount     = "${s.amount.amount} ${s.amount.currency}"
    scope      = [for c in s.scope_chips : "${c.key}: ${join(", ", c.values)}"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Array of pending budget suggestions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `row_count` (Number) Number of suggestions returned.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `alert_thresholds` (List of Number) Suggested alert thresholds as percentages of the amount.
- `amount` (Attributes) Suggested budget amount as a decimal-string value with its currency. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--amount))
- `confidence` (String)
- `config` (String) Draft budget configuration to merge over the create-budget defaults. Value is JSON-encoded.
- `description` (String)
- `generated_time` (String) Timestamp when the suggestion was generated.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `rationale` (String) Explanation of why this budget is suggested.
- `scope_chips` (Attributes List) Human-readable summary of the suggested budget scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--scope_chips))
- `status` (String)
- `time_interval` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Decimal string, e.g. "1234.56".
- `currency` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--items--scope_chips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.scope_chips`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `values` (List of String)
